exposure: Category II Fetal Heart Rate (FHR) monitoring
fetal cord blood pH levels (pH≤7.0, 7.0<pH<7.2 and pH≥7.2)
cohort: 417 women with Category II FHR monitoring indicating need for imminent delivery
finding: In this study of women with Category II FHR requiring imminent delivery, no specific parameter was found to predict fetal acidosis or asphyxia risk beyond the indication for delivery itself.
mod_finding: More patients in the low pH group had cesarean section (55.6%), than vaginal delivery or vacuum extraction
